baseline_models.mechanism: The commanded utterance transfers a bilateral dispute to God as the adequate third-party witness: presence supplies direct observation, knowledge supplies decisive declaration, and the doubled interval locates that testimony across both parties.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech makes the appeal a public act rather than a private conviction.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency supplies the appeal's claim of evidentiary adequacy.
Presence with observation makes the witness direct rather than hearsay-based.
Knowledge-backed declaration gives the observed presence an adjudicative function.
The middle interval supplies the bilateral space across which the testimony operates.

changed_reading.before: God is named as an additional witness to the speaker's claim.
changed_reading.after: The spoken appeal relocates the whole evidentiary burden to a directly present, knowledge-bearing witness whose testimony is sufficient across both parties.

baseline_models.mechanism: The witness has no epistemic blind side: khabir reaches the inward constitution of an affair, basir covers visible conduct and discerning insight, and the servant relation defines the persons whose allegiance is being observed.

activation_trace.role: Obedient worship under submission makes lived allegiance, not only verbal claims, the domain of observation.
Knowledge of reports and inner realities supplies inward access.
Visual perception supplies direct access to outward conduct.
Insight of the heart extends seeing from surfaces to recognition and self-disclosure.

changed_reading.before: God generally knows and sees His servants.
changed_reading.after: God's sufficiency as witness rests on coupled inward expertise and outward vision over the servants' lived allegiance, leaving neither motive nor conduct unobserved.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus saying can function as a boundary on bilateral contention: the negotiation-image of q-w-l is answered by the mapped k-f-f image of restraint, so appeal to the witness stops an otherwise renewable exchange.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair supplies the live speech-contest that the command enters.
The packet's split k-f-f target contributes restraint, making sufficiency function as a stopping boundary.
Separation between parties preserves the contested sides that the stopping rule governs.

changed_reading.before: The speaker offers one more claim in an open-ended dispute.
changed_reading.after: The commanded sentence performs a stopping rule: the dispute is no longer renegotiated between the parties but referred to the sufficient witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer and twice-marked dawn recitation culminate in mashhudan, activating witness as attendance at an enacted event. The final shahidan therefore carries the possibility that God certifies performed recitation and service, not merely a proposition about the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Obligatory worship supplies the enacted practice in which witnessing occurs.
Repeated reading and recitation supplies the audible event presented for witness.
The witnessed recitation explicitly activates presence with observation before the focus use of shahid.
The focus witness carries that attended-event image into the final appeal.

structural_cues: 17:78 closes with مَشْهُودًا after naming dawn recitation twice; 17:96 returns to ش ه د in شَهِيدًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies performed worship, repeated recitation, and an event called witnessed; I infer continuity from witnessed event to witness of the mission. A live alternative is that 17:78 marks only attendance at dawn recitation.

changed_reading.before: Witness means corroboration of a disputed assertion.
changed_reading.after: Witness also means direct attendance at the messenger's enacted recitation and service, so the mission's performance itself lies within the testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated commanded speech is paired first with a request for compelling authority and then with truth's arrival and falsehood's disappearance. The focus command is thus heard as a commissioned verdict backed by divine testimony, not as the speaker's improvised self-defense.

activation_trace.role: A prior commanded utterance establishes speech issued under commission.
Compelling proof supplies the requested backing for that commissioned speech.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the verdict's stable object.
Disappearance until no trace remains supplies the consequence for the opposed false claim.
The focus command continues the series of publicly voiced commissions.
Knowledge-backed declaration supplies the authority that makes the final saying verdict-like.

structural_cues: 17:80 and 17:81 each begin a commanded saying; 17:96 repeats the same command after the dispute over signs and messengership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commissioned sayings, compelling proof, truth's arrival, and falsehood's vanishing; I infer that the final saying inherits verdict force. Alternatively, the earlier formulas may be parallel proclamations without a cumulative juridical sequence.

changed_reading.before: The speaker personally appeals to God for corroboration.
changed_reading.after: The speaker voices a commissioned verdict whose authority lies in the sender-witness and whose criterion is truth that survives while falsehood loses its footing.

context_deltas.mechanism: One recitation yields trust for some and loss for others; turning one's side away externalizes a posture, while each person acts along a shaping direction known to the Lord. The witness between the parties therefore diagnoses receiver-specific uptake by joining inward configuration to outward action.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies one receptive outcome of the recitation.
General diminution supplies the opposite outcome produced in another receiver.
Turning the side away makes an inward refusal bodily observable.
Purposive action supplies the conduct in which disposition becomes effective.
A shaping way or direction supplies the receiver-specific channel guiding action.
Disclosure to the knower supplies divine discrimination among those directions.
Inner expertise anchors the diagnosis in the focus description of the witness.
Direct sight anchors the diagnosis in observable response and conduct.

structural_cues: 17:82 gives the same recitation opposite effects; 17:83-84 move from inward posture to bodily turning, shaping direction, and work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent effects, side-turning, patterned work, and divine knowledge; I infer a diagnostic arrow from inward shaping to outward response. Alternatively, khabir and basir may assert exhaustive knowledge without implying an adjudication of uptake here.

changed_reading.before: God neutrally observes two opposed parties.
changed_reading.after: God witnesses how the same address discloses each party's shaping disposition through its distinct outward response, making the space between them diagnostically unequal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human knowledge is little, hidden impartation can be taken away, no caretaker can secure it against God, and its retention is mercy. Divine sufficiency as witness therefore includes custody of the very evidence humans receive and cannot independently guarantee.

activation_trace.role: Known reality supplies the epistemic measure against which human possession is limited.
Littleness explicitly bounds the recipients' share of knowledge.
Knowledge cast secretly supplies the disclosed evidence whose access is contingent.
Going away supplies the possible removal of that evidence.
One who stands over an affair in sufficiency and preservation supplies the unavailable external guarantor.
Merciful tenderness supplies the stated reason the disclosure remains available.
Adequate undertaking anchors exclusive evidentiary custody in the focus claim.
Knowledge of inner reality contrasts the witness's expertise with the recipients' little knowledge.

structural_cues: 17:85 limits given knowledge; 17:86 makes revelation's removal conditional on divine will; 17:87 marks its retention as mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited human knowledge, removable revelation, lack of a preserving agent against God, and merciful retention; I infer that the witness also controls access to the evidentiary record. Alternatively, these clauses may concern revelation's preservation without defining witnesshood.

changed_reading.before: God is the best-informed observer of evidence shared with everyone.
changed_reading.after: God alone both knows fully and controls the disclosed evidence's availability, so the appeal cannot be escalated to a larger common archive or an independent guarantor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective gathering and mutual backing cannot produce a counterpart to the recitation, even after its examples are repeatedly turned for people; refusal instead covers the disclosed truth. This activates the sign-that-witnesses branch: divine testimony accompanies a publicly exhibited address that opponents cannot answer in kind.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed agents supplies the maximal coalition attempting the comparison.
A matching counterpart supplies the explicit criterion the coalition cannot meet.
Strengthening by mutual backing supplies the coalition's full cooperative advantage.
Repeated turning from form to form supplies public variation of the address's examples.
Covering the truth supplies refusal as concealment rather than successful counterproduction.
A sign that itself indicates a state lets exhibited unanswerability participate in the focus witness-mechanism.

structural_cues: 17:88 maximizes producers and helpers yet denies a matching product; 17:89 follows with varied examples and majority refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed public comparison, varied examples, and truth-covering refusal; I infer that this exhibited failure can carry sign-like witness force under God's testimony. Alternatively, non-replicability may be a separate sign and 17:96 may name only God's personal knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The appeal adds an external witness to a claim that otherwise stands unsupported.
changed_reading.after: God's witness accompanies an exhibited address whose resistance to total collaborative imitation already makes the claim publicly answerable rather than merely asserted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challengers prescribe visible proof as a controlled spectacle: a split-open spring, falling sky, face-to-face presentation, ascent, and a readable writing. The focus answer relocates adequacy from their staged seeing to God's seeing; petitioners cannot set the conditions under which the witness must appear.

activation_trace.role: Broad splitting and emergence supplies the demanded terrestrial spectacle.
Water springing from an eye supplies the demanded visible product.
A thing cast downward supplies the demanded celestial spectacle.
Face-to-face confrontation supplies the demand that God and angels be presented on the challengers' visual terms.
Ascending a stair supplies the demanded vertical feat.
Ordered letters and a written object supply the demanded inspectable artifact.
Declaring something enough directly rejects the endless addition of petitioner-set conditions.
The witness's own direct seeing relocates the decisive visual relation away from the challengers.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 escalate repeated belief conditions from earth, to sky, to direct presentation, to ascent and a personally readable book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escalating visual conditions and the focus supplies divine sufficiency and sight; I infer a reversal from being seen on demand to the challengers being seen by the witness. Alternatively, the final appeal may answer only the messenger objection in 17:94-95, not every earlier demand.

changed_reading.before: God's witness is one more item that might satisfy the challengers' demand for proof.
changed_reading.after: God's witness terminates their proof-design: adequacy lies in the witness who sees them, not in spectacles they require the messenger to stage for their inspection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human embodiment is named as the barrier to accepting the sent one, but the counterfactual assigns an angelic messenger precisely to angels walking settled on earth. God's final witness therefore certifies sender-recipient fit: a human messenger to humans is appropriate mediation, not a defect requiring angelic embodiment.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between a person and the desired end frames the stated objection as blockage.
The visibly skinned human supplies the messenger type treated as objectionable.
Messenger and message supply the office whose embodiment is disputed.
Angelic beings supply both the hypothetical recipients and their fitted messenger.
Walking movement places the hypothetical recipients in an embodied terrestrial mode.
Settled calm makes their residence on earth stable rather than episodic.
Delivery downward supplies the sender's act of fitting a messenger to those recipients.
The angel messenger completes the explicit recipient-messenger correspondence.
Knowledge-backed testimony certifies the appropriateness of the actual commission.
Shared servanthood places messenger and recipients under the same knowledgeable sender-witness.

structural_cues: 17:94 states the human-messenger objection; 17:95 answers with an angel-recipient counterfactual; 17:96 immediately invokes God's witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an embodiment objection and a counterfactual matching messenger type to resident recipient type; I infer that the final witness certifies the actual human-human fit. Alternatively, 17:95 may only rebut the demand for an angel without making fit part of witnesshood.

changed_reading.before: God witnesses that the human messenger is truthful despite his ordinary embodiment.
changed_reading.after: God certifies that human embodiment is the fitting medium for human recipients; the messenger's humanity supports the commission's relational design rather than weakening it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant q-w-l to q-l-l split; it remains anchored through focus قُلْ, context قَلِيلًا, focus كَفَىٰ, and the explicit contrast in knowledge. Render only as a branch-activated verbal-economy reading, never as a claim that قُلْ lexically means little.

activation_trace.role: The split q-l-l target contributes littleness to the commanded saying as an exploratory economy of speech.
Explicitly little knowledge gives the form-distant focus activation a nearby contextual control.
The declaration that something is enough makes brevity functional rather than merely sparse.
The witness's inward expertise supplies the full knowledge against which the human utterance can remain small.

changed_reading.before: The speaker should answer the dispute with as much explanatory proof as possible.
changed_reading.after: The compact final saying performs epistemic discipline: the human voice says little because human knowledge is little, while God's complete knowledge makes the brief appeal sufficient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus k-f-y through the packet's mapped k-f-f branch of people surrounding and looking at a thing. It remains anchored by كَفَىٰ, divine sight, and the gathered coalition in 17:88; render it as a spatial activation of sufficiency, not as the direct lexical sense of كَفَىٰ.

activation_trace.role: The split k-f-f image of a group surrounding something to look supplies an all-around geometry for sufficiency.
Direct vision turns that surrounding geometry into comprehensive observation.
The gathering of dispersed agents supplies the rival collective field.
Mutual backing supplies the coalition's attempted completeness.
Present observation anchors the spatial image in the actual focus function of witness.

changed_reading.before: One divine witness is numerically enough despite the opposing multitude.
changed_reading.after: Divine sufficiency can be pictured as an all-around field of present observation that no gathered, mutually backing multitude can reproduce or escape.

strongest_changes: Witness shifted from generic corroboration to direct attendance at enacted recitation and receiver-specific conduct.
The final appeal now terminates petitioner-designed spectacle by relocating decisive sight and evidentiary custody to God.
The human messenger's embodiment became evidence of recipient-fit rather than a defect in the commission.
summary.what_was_special: The context made shahid simultaneously judicial, performative, diagnostic, and commission-certifying. The packet's split mappings also yielded two contained outliers: little speech as epistemic discipline and circumambient observation as sufficiency.
remaining_uncertainties: The witnessed dawn recitation may be a root echo rather than a direct model for 17:96 witnesshood.
The recitation's failed imitation may function as a separate sign rather than as part of God's witness.
Both split-root outliers are intentionally form-distant and must not be lexicalized as direct translations.
